# Template overview

The Copier source of truth lives in `template/`.

```text
template/
  copier.yml          # Questions + post-copy tasks; picks subdirectory
  backend/            # FastAPI + platform-kit Jinja tree
  frontend/           # Vite + ui-kit Jinja tree
  README.md
  HANDOFF.md
```

## Design goals

- **One template, two stacks** — `stack` switches `_subdirectory` between `backend` and `frontend`.
- **Layout matrix without forks** — monorepo vs polyrepo, monolith vs microservices, Kafka on/off, Nx/moon/none, SaaS vs API-only.
- **Baseline vs product code** — kits are protected; modules/features are where teams work.
- **Enforcement everywhere** — `dx check`, pre-commit, AI hooks, CI.

## How rendering works

`copier.yml` sets:

```yaml
_subdirectory: "{{ 'frontend' if stack == 'frontend' else 'backend' }}"
```

Jinja conditionals inside each tree emit only the files needed for the chosen answers (compose services, contracts package, nx/moon configs, AI rule packs, SaaS extras, etc.).

## Relationship to examples

| Example folder | What you get in the tree |
|---|---|
| `backend/mono-monolith` | Monorepo monolith + identity/billing/Redis (SaaS in tree) |
| `backend/mono-micro-kafka-nx` | Microservices + Kafka + Nx (single `core-api` + items) |
| `backend/mono-micro-moon` | Microservices + moon, HTTP only |
| `backend/poly-kit` | Shared platform-kit + contracts publisher |
| `backend/poly-service-kafka` | Standalone service pinning the kit |
| `frontend/web-spa` | Vite SPA + ui-kit + items feature |

:::warning Stale answers on backend examples
All `backend/*` `.copier-answers.yml` still point at an older `_src_path` (`fastapi-platform-template-and-cases/1-template`) and **omit** `stack` / `platform_profile`. Only `frontend/web-spa` was generated from `./template`. Layout fields in answers still match the rough matrix; regenerate backends to record current answers.
:::

Examples are **reference outputs**. Prefer regenerating them from `./template` when the template evolves (see [HANDOFF](./handoff.mdx)).
